C1292.title: Epaylinks Payment Fined and Confiscated About RMB 48.35 Million for Payment Settlement, Fintech, and AML Violations
keywords: People's Bank of China Guangdong Branch
C1292.summary: On June 4, 2026, the Guangdong Branch of the People's Bank of China disclosed penalty decisions No. 10-12 of 2026. Epaylinks Payment violated payment settlement, fintech, and anti-money-laundering rules. The regulator confiscated RMB 10.0516 million in illegal gains and imposed a RMB 38.2974 million fine, totaling RMB 48.3490 million; two responsible individuals were separately fined RMB 375,000 and RMB 20,000.
